project_journey.description: Kaggle value is descriptive highest selected XGBoost AUROC across historical versions, not a new model choice.

numerical_data.label:
Kaggle V3 XGBoost
internal CV, binary

transfer_gap.description: Exact per-seed values are the inputs to each documented mean.

label_efficiency.description: Nine adapted episodes; three unique Source-only seeds repeated by design. Budget keys from DEVELOPMENT_SUMMARY.json/budgets.

contrast_forest.description: All adopted contrasts and budgets. Bonferroni intervals only for the four B128 secondary contrasts.

primary_episodes.description: Seed identities are in the corresponding episode objects, not patient identifiers.

mask_heatmap.description: All registered masks, no outcome-selected subset. Zero/one colour encodes SHARE/ADAPT, not numeric evidence strength.

phase2_vs_phase3b.description: No cross-study hypothesis test or meta-analysis; label budgets and source replication differ.
